040        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);

072    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
073        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
074        this.cargo = raw;
075        parseBase(raw);
076        this.swUpdateStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
077        this.metadataAndVersionStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
078        this.fullDlAndCrcStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
079        this.fileDlAndSideloadStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
080        this.externalFlashStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
081        this.updateSuccessful = raw[20] & 0xFF;
082        this.swPartNum = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
083
084    }

086    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int swUpdateStatus, int metadataAndVersionStatus, int fullDlAndCrcStatus, int fileDlAndSideloadStatus, int externalFlashStatus, int updateSuccessful, long swPartNum) {
087        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
088            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(203, 0),
089            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
090            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
091            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(swUpdateStatus),
092            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(metadataAndVersionStatus),
093            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(fullDlAndCrcStatus),
094            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(fileDlAndSideloadStatus),
095            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(externalFlashStatus),
096            new byte[]{(byte) updateSuccessful, 0},
097            Bytes.toUint32(swPartNum)));
098    }
